visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit, modern indoor residential space, specifically a dining area adjoining a living room. A woman with dark hair gathered in a high bun, dressed in a vibrant, multi-colored pastel knitted cardigan, is seated at a white circular table. To her right sits a man with short dark hair, wearing a solid forest-green short-sleeved t-shirt. On the white table, two white plates are visible; one contains a partially eaten hamburger, while the other holds a few golden-brown fried chicken nuggets. The woman is initially focused on her plate, while the man reaches out with his hand. (2) The man picks up a single chicken nugget and holds it out towards the woman's face as an offering. The woman is currently distracted, looking down at her silver smartphone which is lying flat on the white table surface. The man maintains the gesture, waiting for her to look up. The room's background is expansive, featuring white walls, a large wall-mounted flat-screen television, and large windows that let in ample natural sunlight, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. (3) The woman finally notices the man's gesture, looks at him with a smile, and leans her head forward with her mouth open, intending to take a bite of the offered nugget. Just as she reaches for it, the man swiftly retracts his hand, popping the nugget into his own mouth instead while grinning widely. He then immediately reaches across the table with his other hand and snatched the woman's hamburger off her plate. (4) The woman reacts with an expression of exaggerated shock and amusement, her eyes widening as she realizes she has been pranked. She stands up quickly from her chair, and the man also jumps up, clutching the burger and running away into the background of the living room. The camera remains static as she playfully chases him across the open space. The scene concludes with the man running towards the far end of the room near the windows.
